coordination: Advisory Git task claims; read builder-workflow.md before claiming.

tasks.title: Validate personal loot, overflow, rewards and reconnect
tasks.scope: Audit existing authority and duplicate protection. Exercise loot intake, full pack behavior, repeated reward claims and save/rejoin without modifying creator characters.
tasks.acceptance: Evidence for owner isolation, no duplicate grants, documented overflow behavior and save/rejoin; identify or repair failures before trade expansion.

tasks.title: Validate the existing Wayside Forge
tasks.scope: Temper, Reforge and Ascend already exist. Test dust costs, level caps, rarity eligibility, distance, duplicate input and save/rejoin; do not recreate them.
tasks.acceptance: Valid operations apply once and charge once; invalid operations preserve inventory/dust; save compatibility verified.

tasks.title: Finish one original Abbey prop or environment set
tasks.scope: Inspect current generation crews and placed art first. Select an unfinished nonoverlapping detail consistent with the atlas and art references; model/import it with provenance and LOD/collision appropriate to its use.
tasks.acceptance: Actual CDN/model or scripted geometry placed and visually reviewed; traversal remains clear; performance impact measured or explicitly unverified.

tasks.title: Verify one chapter with natural play and reconnect
tasks.scope: Study matching quest records and live stage mapping. Choose an existing chapter whose previous test used forced state. Test natural progression, boss fight, repeated turn-in and reconnect on a test character.
tasks.acceptance: Quest gates, boss completion and reward idempotence supported by recorded play evidence; failures repaired or documented before expansion.

tasks.title: Add a small profession and recipe progression slice
tasks.scope: Extend the verified forge with an original source-defined profession/recipe loop; preserve existing loot and saves.
tasks.acceptance: Earn materials, learn recipe, craft/equip and reconnect without lost or duplicated inputs/rewards.
